comment: ArduPilot parameter descriptor database. Maps parameter names to UI metadata.

serial.description: Configure ArduPilot logical serial port protocols and baud rates. Note: SERIAL number is the logical port (ArduPilot parameter name), not the physical port number. Check your board's hardware manual for physical-to-logical mapping.

_PROTOCOL.description: Protocol used on this serial port

_BAUD.description: Baud rate for this serial port

servo.description: Assign functions to servo output channels. Actual output count depends on your board (common: 8, 12, or 16 channels). Channels beyond your board's capability will show as unavailable.

_FUNCTION.description: Function assigned to this servo output

rc.description: Assign functions to RC input channels

_FUNCTION.description: Function assigned to this RC input channel

flight_mode.description: Map flight mode switch positions to modes

ARMING_CHECK.description: Bitmask of pre-arm checks performed before arming

TELEM1_BAUD.description: Legacy telemetry port baud-rate parameter alias

ardupilot_4_8.note: 仅取结构性字段；描述文本已移除，见 metadata_note

roles.comment: 语义角色 → 固件参数名。角色名由通用前端定义（与固件和机型无关），参数名只在此处提供；S6 要求通用前端代码不得出现固件专属参数名字面量。值里的 {n} 是序号占位符，由前端替换（如 RC{n}_OPTION → RC7_OPTION）。角色名里带 _legacy 的是旧版固件的旧参数名（如 takeoff.alt_cm_legacy = PILOT_TKOFF_ALT，4.7 起改用 takeoff.alt_m）；带 _fallback_m 的是当前参数缺失时的降级来源。
